content:
{{DPS calculator}}

This article is about calculating ranged damage output.
Range damage is affected by the [[Equipment]] used, [[prayer]], [[Temporary skill boost|skill boosts]] and the [[monster]] being attacked.

There are various methods by which players can increase their potential '''[[Ranged]] damage'''. The effects of most equipped items can be seen in the [[Equipment Stats|stats window]] (labelled as Range: +x and Ranged strength: +x).

== Calculating your ranged damage output ==
{{:Maximum ranged hit}}

=== Step four: Calculate the ''effective ranged attack'' ===

<math>\text{Effective Ranged Attack} =\left\lfloor (\left\lfloor (\text{Ranged Level}+\text{Boost})*\text{Prayer Bonus} \right\rfloor +\text{Atk Style}+8)*\text{Void Modifier} \right\rfloor</math>

If you are using the accurate attack style ''Atk Style'' is 3 while all other styles are 0.

''Void Modifier'' is 1 if not wearing void, 1.1 if wearing either full ranged void or full elite ranged void.

'''Prayer Multiplier:'''
{| class="wikitable"
<tr><th colspan="2">Prayer</th></tr>
|-
|[[Sharp Eye]]
|1.05
|-
|[[Hawk Eye]]
|1.10
|-
|[[Eagle Eye]]
|1.15
|-
|[[Deadeye]]
|1.18
|-
|[[Rigour]]
|1.20
|}
Note that the only difference between effective ranged strength and effective ranged attack is the value for Rigour and void.

=== Step five: Calculate the ''Attack roll'' ===
<math>\text{Atk roll} =\left\lfloor \text{Effective Ranged Attack}*(\text{Equipment Ranged Attack}+64)*\text{Gear Bonus} \right\rfloor</math>

The Equipment Attack bonus can be found in the Equipment Stats window under the heading 'Attack Bonus'.

The gear bonus is the same as in Step 2.

Twisted bow accuracy modifier is also included in the gear bonus and does stack with slayer/salve (multiply by both modifiers). However, the tbow modifier is less straightforward to calculate as it is not constant: see it's page [[Twisted bow|here]] to calculate it based on your opponent.  Thus it does not multiply your accuracy output, it just multiplies your attack roll.

=== Step six: Calculate the ''Defence roll'' ===
<math>\text{Def roll} =(\text{Target Defence Level}+9)*(\text{Target Ranged Defence Bonus}+64)</math>

Target's Defence is denoted by a shield icon on the target's wiki page.

Target's ranged defence can be found under the 'Defensive stats' heading.

=== Step seven: Calculate the ''hit chance''===
'''If Attack Roll > Defence roll:'''

<math>\text{Hit Chance} =1-\frac{\text{Def roll} + 2}{2*(\text{Atk roll}+1)}</math>

'''Else'''

<math>\text{Hit Chance} =\frac{\text{Atk roll}}{2*(\text{Def roll}+1)}</math>

=== Step eight: Calculate the ''ranged damage output''===
<math>\text{Damage per hit} = \text{Hit Chance} * \Biggl(\frac{\text{Maximum hit}}{2}+\frac{\text{1}}{\text{Maximum hit}+1}\Biggr)</math>

To calculate the Damage Per Second, divide the Damage Per hit by the attack speed of the weapon in seconds.
Note that the rapid attack style decreases the attack speed by 1 tick.
